Quality Thought, a software training institute, is conducting a Free Demo on Full Stack Python with Gen-AI Training on 24 September 2026 at 10:30 AM onwards, available in both Online and Offline modes. This demo is designed for students, freshers, graduates, job seekers, working professionals, and aspiring software developers who want to explore Full Stack Python development along with the latest Generative AI technologies.

The session provides an opportunity to understand how Python, Front-End Development, Back-End Development, Databases, APIs, Cloud Technologies, and Generative AI can be combined to build modern, industry-oriented applications. Participants can explore the learning roadmap and understand the skills required to develop full-stack applications using Python while incorporating AI capabilities into software projects.

During the Free Demo, participants can gain an introduction to important Full Stack Python concepts, including Python programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Django or Flask, REST APIs, SQL, databases, Git, deployment, and cloud fundamentals. The session also introduces the growing role of Generative AI in software development, including AI-assisted coding, application development, productivity tools, prompt engineering concepts, and AI-powered development workflows.

This Free Demo is suitable for beginners who want to understand how to start a career in Full Stack Python as well as professionals looking to upgrade their development skills with Generative AI. Participants can learn about the technologies involved, practical project development, industry-oriented skills, and the overall roadmap for becoming a modern full-stack developer.

Who Can Attend?

  • Any Degree Graduates
  • Engineering Graduates
  • Freshers
  • Students
  • Job Seekers
  • Aspiring Python Developers
  • Software Developers
  • Working IT Professionals
  • Career Switchers
  • Professionals interested in Generative AI

No advanced programming expertise is required to attend the introductory demo. Beginners can use the session to understand the learning path, while those with existing programming experience can explore how Full Stack Python skills can be enhanced with Generative AI.

What You Can Explore:

The demo provides an overview of Python Programming, Front-End Development, Back-End Development, React, Django/Flask, SQL, REST APIs, Git, Cloud Fundamentals, Generative AI, AI-assisted development, Prompt Engineering, and AI-powered application development.

Participants can also understand how practical projects can help connect theoretical concepts with real-world software development requirements. The session can help you identify the technologies and skills to focus on when building a career in Full Stack Python and AI-enabled application development.

Why Attend the Free Demo?

Understand the Full Stack Python career roadmap, explore modern development technologies, learn about the integration of Generative AI with software development, discover practical learning opportunities, and get an overview of the skills needed for today's technology environment.

  • Demo Date: 24 September 2026
  • Time: 10:30 AM onwards
  • Mode: Online & Offline
  • Organized by: Quality Thought

Register for the Free Full Stack Python with Gen-AI Demo and explore the skills needed to build modern web applications with Python and Generative AI.
